name: Bother Rhapsody
source:
A vampire named Kyle lives quietly in his house with a were-cat girl. But one day their peaceful everyday suddenly gets crushed.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个名叫凯尔的吸血鬼和一个猫人女孩安静地住在他的房子里。但有一天，他们平静的日常生活突然被打破了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
